column1: Two completed specialist studies: 1M and 30.2M, each 11 targets x 3 profiles x 5 seeds = 165 fits. Total 330.
Three prespecified profiles only: uniform 1/11; 90% target + 1% per auxiliary; 100% target + zero auxiliary loss. No dense search or interpolation.
Same eleven-head MLP, full encoder fine-tuning, frozen IL split, balanced sampling, training-only scaling and target validation checkpoint selection.
Circle = 1M; triangle = 30.2M. Grey = uniform; green = 90%; light purple = 100%. Heatmap green/purple separately encodes improvement/worsening.
Main panel b chooses the smaller five-seed mean test MAE among 90%/100% at each scale/property, excluding uniform. Retrospective, not deployment selection.
Main panel c shows validation standardized-MSE percentage reduction versus each scale/property uniform; outline selects minimum validation MSE. Exact paired seed SDs in source data.
Main panel d shows ALL THREE arms at BOTH scales, unlike the earlier single-scale artwork which showed uniform/best/selected summaries.
Main d denominator is the smallest five-seed mean test MAE among six tabular configurations: Extra Trees, TabPFN and LimiX, two representations each. Descriptive only.
FigS_validation_selected uses validation choices for both GNN and tabular models, and displays held-out test performance. No best-seed selections.
Gain whiskers = SD of paired seed differences divided by the fixed control mean. Ratio whiskers = numerator seed SD / fixed tabular mean. Neither includes denominator or selection uncertainty.
Equal-IL companion holds profile and tabular configuration choices fixed from primary measurement-weighted analysis. No new equal-IL selection.
FigS_auxiliary_benefit compares 90% with the matched 100% target control. Improvement against uniform alone does not establish useful auxiliary supervision.
Original 66-test BH families are checked separately within each scale and copied unchanged. No new cross-scale or post-selection hypothesis tests.
Primary viscosity MAE uses ln space; primary CO2 MAE uses native mole fraction. Validation standardized MSE uses log targets for both. Cp source units remain unverified.
1M: 4510 freshly refreshed frozen-row/metric audits. 30.2M: 4510 inherited audits tied to unchanged files; shared tabular entries occur in both reports.
780 distinct model artifact sets re-hashed. Main figures use 330 specialist and 330 tabular models; 120 historical graph models are audited contextual references.
Single pretrained checkpoint per scale; both data and pretraining compute differ. Across-scale differences are descriptive, not an isolated data-only effect.
No fitting or inference was run. Repeated test inspection requires grouped/external confirmation for strong generalization claims.
